title: 第5章  创武师第6章  燃钢之心哥布林
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
傅佳佳都惊呆了！
擂台上，那个在高中一直在挨打，从来没雄起过的杨铁牛。
在面对E级铁甲战士后，跟个血牛一样，坚毅不倒。
突然还鼻口喘着粗气，将那铁甲战士撞倒在地。
就离大谱，有这力量，你早干嘛去了。
早撞它不就完事了吗！
擂台下，那个高中三年已经被证明是假天才的苏青。
一声招呼不打，就往她身上倒。
被她用双脚架住之后，马上就摸向胸口。
这不是耍流氓吗！
要不是看他面色煞白，一副要死的样子。
她早一脚把他踹飞，哪里容得了他这么放肆！
没想到她一念之仁，却遇到了此生以来最大的机缘。
看着苏青身上泛着的微微白光。
傅佳佳哪里不知道这是创武成功，武道功德反馈的征兆！
苏青创武成功了！
那自己双脚撑着的哪里还是个人?
这是金灿灿的大腿，是她傅佳佳明媚的前途啊。
死腿不要抖了，能不要这么没出息，快给我稳住，让创武师大人在我脚下安稳休息啊！
可惜，为创武师大人服务的时间不长。

在苏青从武道功德中回味过来后。
就离开了支撑他的双脚。
对傅佳佳点头道了声谢后，发现他周围已经里三圈，外三圈围满了人。
站在最前面的正是金丝眼镜李三全。
“我就说今天出门有喜鹊叫，一定有好事来登门。
你看果然吧，我们天一武院出了位创武师，这还不是天大的好事！”
他喜笑颜开的跟周围人说着话。
可其他考官点头如捣蒜，王海梅却有不同意见。
她温柔的拉过苏青的手：“苏同学，作为江夏第一高中教职人员的家属，我由衷为你今天的成就感到高兴。
我已经跟我家老李通电话了，待会他就来带你去武道局登记这门武学！”
王海梅话音刚落，李三全连忙道：“江夏第一高中为我武院输送人才，的确值得表彰。
但这登记武学的事，还是由我带苏青去吧，毕竟他现在是我天一武院的人。”
“李校这话说的，苏青高中毕业典礼还没办，学籍都还在江夏第一高中，不是江夏第一高中的人，还能是谁的人！”江海梅蹙眉道。
培养出一位新的创武师，对于他们这些教职人员而言有莫大好处。
她虽然是天一武院的老师，却还是第一高中校长的老婆。
content_en:
Fu Jiajia was shocked!
In the ring, Yang Tieniu, who had been beaten in high school and never rose to prominence.
After facing the E-class armored warrior, he was as perseverant as a bloody bull.
Suddenly he was breathing heavily and knocked the armored warrior to the ground.
Just leave Dapu. With this power, why would you have gone there long ago?
Wouldn't it be over if we hit it early?
Under the ring, Su Qing, who had been proven to be a fake genius in three years of high school.
Without saying hello, he poured it on her.
After being supported by her feet, she immediately touched her chest.
Isn’t this a hooligan act?
If it weren't for the fact that his face was pale and he looked like he was about to die.
She had kicked him away a long time ago, how could she tolerate him being so presumptuous!
Unexpectedly, her one thought of kindness would lead to her encountering the greatest opportunity in her life.
Looking at the faint white light glowing on Su Qing's body.
Fu Jiajia didn't know that this was a sign of successful martial arts creation and feedback of martial arts merits!
Su Qing Chuangwu succeeded!
Then where are you holding your feet and still a human being?
These are golden thighs and her Fu Jiajia's bright future.
Stop shaking your dead legs. Can you please stop being so useless? Just hold on to me and let Master Chuangwu Master rest peacefully at my feet!
It's a pity that he didn't serve Master Sou Martial Arts Master for long.
After Su Qing recalled the merits of martial arts.
He left his feet supporting him.
After nodding and thanking Fu Jiajia, he found that there were three circles around him, and the other three circles were full of people.
Standing at the front is Li Sanquan with gold-rimmed glasses.
"I said if there were magpies chirping when I went out today, something good must be coming to my door.
You see, it’s true that our Tianyi Martial Academy has a creative martial arts master. This is not a huge good thing! "
He smiled happily and talked to the people around him.
But while the other examiners nodded, Wang Haimei had different opinions.
She gently took Su Qing's hand: "Student Su, as a family member of a faculty member of Jiangxia No. 1 High School, I am sincerely happy for your achievements today.
I have already spoken to my old Mr. Li on the phone. He will come and take you to the Martial Arts Bureau to register this martial arts! "
As soon as Wang Haimei finished speaking, Li Sanquan said quickly: "Jiangxia No. 1 High School is indeed worthy of commendation for providing talents to our martial arts academy.
But for the matter of registering for martial arts, I should take Su Qing there. After all, he is now a member of our Tianyi Martial Academy. "
"What School Li said, the graduation ceremony of Su Qing High School has not been held yet, and his student status is still in Jiangxia No. 1 High School. If he is not from Jiangxia No. 1 High School, who else can he be from!" Jiang Haimei frowned.
Cultivating a new creative martial artist is of great benefit to the teaching staff.
Although she is a teacher at Tianyi Martial Arts Academy, she is also the wife of the principal of No. 1 High School.
